user.title: Alpicool BLE fridge
user.description: Confirm the Bluetooth address of your fridge. Only one client can be connected at a time, so close the vendor app before finishing setup.

data_description.address: Accepted as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, aa-bb-cc-dd-ee-ff or aabbccddeeff.
data_description.name: Shown as the device name in Home Assistant.
data_description.dual_zone_modes: Leave this off unless your dual zone fridge switches between a combined Fridge mode and a Freezer mode. It does not control whether a second zone is created — that is detected automatically. With this on, the second zone is only available while the fridge is in Freezer mode.

error.invalid_address: That is not a valid Bluetooth address. Use AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, aa-bb-cc-dd-ee-ff or aabbccddeeff.

data_description.dual_zone_modes: Leave this off unless your dual zone fridge switches between a combined Fridge mode and a Freezer mode. It does not control whether a second zone is created — that is detected automatically.
data_description.left_name: For example Left, Top or Fridge.
data_description.right_name: For example Right, Bottom or Freezer. Only used on dual zone models.
